page.layout: One block of running text under the running head; below it a centred subscription "Libri Primi.", a centred word "FINIS.", and a woodcut ornament. Page number at the head right.

main_text.p: media nocte computetur. Sed' Arabes ab occasu solis dies suos deducunt, ut ante monuimus. Jam vero Sol occidit, octavo enim post meridiem hora sonuit. Dies itaque Rabiæ posterioris 18 jam cœptus est & fluit. Nos summam igitur manum primo huic Institutionum Chronologicarum Libro imposuimus, anno Christi 1667 Sept. 26. anno autem Hegiræ 1078. Rabiæ poster. 18.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: The running head reads "Lib.I." in roman, "Chronologicarum." in italic. The page number is 85 in the head right. The "FINIS." line is set in spaced capitals. The woodcut ornament below is not transcribed. Faint watermark text "Digitized by Google" at the lower right is not transcribed.
